description.zh: 12 个通用界面图标：扁平几何造型、饱和配色，每个都内置一段轻量 CSS 动画（弹跳 / 漂浮 / 旋转 / 脉冲）。80×80 画布，单文件自包含，可直接内联到网页、按钮或空状态插画中。
description.en: 12 everyday UI icons in a flat geometric style with saturated colors. Each one ships a lightweight built-in CSS animation (pop / float / spin / pulse). 80×80 viewBox, self-contained single files ready to inline into pages, buttons or empty-state illustrations.

description.zh: 琥珀黄五角星，节奏性轻微放大。适合收藏、评分、精选标记。
description.en: Amber five-pointed star with a gentle rhythmic scale-up. Great for favorites, ratings and featured badges.

description.zh: 橙红色爱心，像心跳一样微微鼓动。用于点赞、喜欢、关注。
description.en: Orange-red heart that throbs softly like a heartbeat. Use for likes, loves and follows.

description.zh: 紫色折线闪电，弹跳强调。适合快速操作、充电、性能与“加速”提示。
description.en: Purple zig-zag lightning bolt with a punchy pop. Fits quick actions, charging, performance and “boost” hints.

description.zh: 蓝色八齿齿轮，匀速慢转。用于设置、偏好、处理中状态。
description.en: Blue eight-tooth gear rotating slowly and steadily. For settings, preferences and processing states.

description.zh: 浅蓝三段式云朵，上下轻轻漂浮。适合云同步、上传、天气。
description.en: Light-blue three-lobed cloud bobbing up and down. Suits cloud sync, uploads and weather.

description.zh: 红色地图定位针，带呼吸式脉冲。标记地点、当前位置或门店。
description.en: Red map pin with a breathing pulse. Marks places, current location or store finders.

description.zh: 薄荷绿圆角对话气泡，弹跳提示新消息。用于评论、私信、客服入口。
description.en: Mint rounded speech bubble that pops to signal new messages. For comments, DMs and support entry points.

description.zh: 海蓝色相机，镜头居中，缓慢漂浮。适合拍照、上传图片、相册。
description.en: Ocean-blue camera with a centered lens, gently floating. For photos, image upload and galleries.

description.zh: 洋红双音符，随节拍轻弹。用于音乐、音频播放、声音设置。
description.en: Magenta beamed double note bouncing to the beat. For music, audio playback and sound settings.

description.zh: 绿色圆形底白色对勾，柔和脉冲。表示成功、完成、已验证。
description.en: White check mark on a green circle with a soft pulse. Signals success, done or verified.

description.zh: 橙色粗箭头指向右侧，弹跳引导。用于下一步、前往、行动号召按钮。
description.en: Chunky orange arrow pointing right with a nudging pop. For next steps, “go” and call-to-action buttons.

description.zh: 明黄四角星芒，持续旋转。适合新功能、AI 魔法、高亮提示。
description.en: Bright yellow four-point sparkle spinning continuously. Great for new features, AI magic and highlights.
